title: Green roof costs for Czechia: installation and annual maintenance (CZK)
unit_note: Prices per m² of roof area. Record 1 = installation (investment) cost in CZK/m²; record 5 = annual maintenance cost in CZK/m²/yr, converted from EUR at the CNB rate of 24.385 CZK/EUR (18 Nov 2026). cost_min/cost_max cover the first (extensive) range in cost_text. cost_average = (cost_min + cost_max) / 2.

records.source: UJEP Ústí n. L., report for key stakeholders no. 4
records.notes: Typical realisation cost, substrate 8–15 cm. Intensive: 2,000–4,000 Kč/m².
Also: retention 20–50 l/m² (extensive); roof membrane life +10–20 yr. Table text extracted unclearly: verify in original. Intensive range: 2.5–4 EUR/m²/yr (≈ 60.96–97.54 CZK/m²/yr).
records.exchange_rate_source: Czech National Bank (CNB) rate declared for 18 Nov 2026
